title: Business Analytics Intern
description: Business Analytics Intern Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Deine Mission Du begeisterst dich für Datenanalyse und möchtest deine Fähigkeiten in einem dynamischen, praxisnahen Umfeld einsetzen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams als Business Analytics Intern und unterstütze uns dabei, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und unsere Geschäftsprozesse weiterzuentwickeln. In dieser Rolle automatisierst du Workflows, analysierst kommerzielle Kennzahlen und gewinnst wertvolle Erkenntnisse aus komplexen Daten. Außerdem arbeitest du an Energiesimulationen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team Python-basierte Tools weiter – beispielsweise für die Simulation von Batteriespeichern oder die Bewertung innovativer Energieversorgungslösungen. Das Praktikum bietet dir umfassende praktische Erfahrungen an der Schnittstelle von Analytics und Energiewirtschaft. Du erhältst Einblicke in ein schnelllebiges Umfeld und hast die Möglichkeit, im Anschluss in eine Werkstudent:innenrolle zu wechseln. Wenn du Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, datenbasierte Lösungen zu entwickeln und die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Das Team Du wirst Teil des Commercial-Teams und unterstützt unsere Go-to-Market-Aktivitäten mit Potenzialanalysen, Energiesimulationen und kommerziellen Auswertungen. Dabei arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Energiewirtschaft, Datenanalyse und Vertrieb und hilfst uns, das wirtschaftliche Potenzial von Energieanlagen und innovativen Versorgungslösungen zu bewerten. Deine Projekte Profitabilitätsanalysen und Energiedatenmodellierung Du führst Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnungen für Industriekund:innen durch, bereitest Energiedaten auf und entwickelst Modelle zur Bewertung verschiedener Energieversorgungslösungen. Workflow-Automatisierung und Prozessoptimierung Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Abläufe und entwickelst datenbasierte Automatisierungslösungen, die unsere internen Prozesse effizienter und skalierbarer machen. Energiesimulationen und Batteriesteuerung Du nutzt Python-basierte Simulationen für energiewirtschaftliche Anwendungsfälle und entwickelst sie weiter – beispielsweise zur intelligenten Steuerung von Batteriespeichern oder zur Bewertung innovativer Versorgungslösungen. Datenanalyse und Visualisierung Du analysierst Energie-, Preis- und kommerzielle Daten, identifizierst relevante Zusammenhänge und bereitest deine Erkenntnisse in aussagekräftigen Visualisierungen für Fallstudien, die Website, Vertriebsaktivitäten und interne Stakeholder auf. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten Datenanalyse und Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnungen: Du analysierst umfangreiche Energie- und Preisdaten unserer Kund:innen und führst mithilfe unserer Simulationstools detaillierte Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnungen für verschiedene Energieversorgungslösungen durch. Simulationen und Angebotserstellung: Du wertest Simulationsergebnisse aus und unterstützt das Team dabei, maßgeschneiderte und datenbasierte Angebote für potenzielle Kund:innen zu entwickeln – beispielsweise für Batteriespeicher und innovative Versorgungslösungen. Prozessautomatisierung und Projektarbeit: Du setzt eigenständig Projekte zur Automatisierung und Optimierung von Daten- und Analyseprozessen um. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit interdisziplinären Teams an konkreten Kunden- und Produktanwendungen zusammen. Recherche und Weiterentwicklung: Du recherchierst wissenschaftliche Publikationen sowie neue regulatorische Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Energie und Nachhaltigkeit und prüfst deren Relevanz für unsere Projekte. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du deine Kenntnisse in Data Science, Prozessautomatisierung und Softwareentwicklung kontinuierlich weiter. Wen wir suchen Du bist derzeit in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang in Data Science, Informatik, Statistik, Mathematik, Physik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem verwandten Fachbereich eingeschrieben. Du bringst erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Data Science und ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten mit. Du verfügst über Grundkenntnisse in Python für die Datenanalyse. Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge. Erste praktische Berufserfahrung ist von Vorteil. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Das Praktikum findet vor Ort in Berlin statt. Tageweises Arbeiten im Homeoffice ist möglich. Wir ermutigen dich, dich auch dann zu bewerben, wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst. Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Erfahrungen. Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen Nach sechs Wochen: Onboarding Du verstehst trawas Geschäftsmodell, unsere Produkte, Kund:innen und zentrale energiewirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge. Du bist mit unseren Datenstrukturen, Simulationstools und Analyseprozessen vertraut und kannst erste Analysen mit Unterstützung des Teams eigenständig durchführen. Im dritten Monat: Ramp-up Du setzt eigenständig ein Projekt in einem der Bereiche Datenanalyse, Workflow-Automatisierung, Profitabilitätsanalyse oder Energiesimulation um. Du unterstützt die Erstellung kundenindividueller Angebote, indem du Energie-, Preis- und kommerzielle Daten analysierst und Simulationsergebnisse in klare Handlungsempfehlungen übersetzt. Warum trawa? Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kund:innen und die Umwelt haben. Das erwartet dich bei uns: Dein Impact: Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unserem dynamischen Team und gestaltest aktiv innovative Produkte, die die Energiewende vorantreiben und zur Dekarbonisierung der Industrie beitragen. Dein Beitrag hat direkten Einfluss, und du kannst stolz auf deine Ergebnisse sein. Flexibles Arbeiten: In unserem schönen Büro fördern wir eine lebendige Unternehmenskultur, in der wir gerne gemeinsam arbeiten. Gleichzeitig ist tageweises Arbeiten im Homeoffice möglich. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und 30 Urlaubstagen unterstützen wir deine Work-Life-Balance. Attraktive Benefits: Neben einer wettbewerbsfähigen Vergütung erhältst du Essensgutscheine und eine Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft. Persönliche Entwicklung: Du arbeitest mit modernen Technologien und lernst von erfahrenen Expert:innen aus der Branche. Vielfalt und Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen. Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein, der Vielfalt wertschätzt. Deshalb ermutigen wir Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft sowie körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung. Über trawa Willkommen im trawa-Universum ! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wie machen wir das? Wir schaffen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarkts zu bewältigen, und professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite. Erste Adresse im Haus. Prüfungen & Behördenkontakt. Du koordinierst in- und externe Prüfungen, führst die Kommunikation mit BaFin sowie Bundesbank und steuerst externe Kanzleien und Berater dort, wo wir spezialisierte Unterstützung brauchen. Regulatorische Funktionen. Du übernimmst regulatorische Mandate, insbesondere die Rolle des stellvertretenden Geldwäschebeauftragten (Deputy MLRO) und des Datenschutzbeauftragten. Neue Produkte & strategische Projekte. Du begleitest die Auflage neuer Fonds mit Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaften und Depotbanken sowie unsere internationale Expansion rechtlich von der Struktur bis zur Umsetzung. Verträge, Arbeits- und Datenschutzrecht. Du verantwortest das Vertragswesen und berätst in den weiteren Rechtsgebieten, die ein wachsender Asset Manager täglich berührt. Deine Erfahrung Zwei juristische Staatsexamen mit überdurchschnittlichen Ergebnissen. Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Aufsichtsrecht für Finanzinstitute, erworben in einer Großkanzlei, einer renommierten Boutique oder in-house bei einem regulierten Institut. Sicherer Umgang mit den einschlägigen Regelwerken: WpIG, WpHG, KAGB, MaRisk, MaComp und GwG. Belastbare Kenntnisse in weiteren Rechtsgebieten, insbesondere Vertrags-, Arbeits- und Datenschutzrecht. Du erfasst komplexe aufsichtsrechtliche Sachverhalte schnell, entscheidest eigenständig und begleitest die Umsetzung federführend. Bereitschaft, regulatorische Funktionen persönlich zu übernehmen und die damit verbundene Verantwortung zu tragen. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch. 2 Gründe dich nicht zu bewerben Du möchtest dich auf ein einzelnes Rechtsgebiet spezialisieren? Du arbeitest lieber im Kanzlei-Set-up mit Zuarbeit und mehreren Prüfschleifen? Bei uns bist du die Rechtsfunktion und triffst Entscheidungen selbst. Wir bieten dir dafür viel Gestaltungsfreiraum, unter anderem beim Aufbau einer Junior-Position an deiner Seite. Dein Mindset Du besitzt eine Leidenschaft für Aktien, Finanzmärkte und Technologie. Du verstehst Regulatorik als Fundament einer gesunden Organisation und nicht als Bremse. Du sagst klar, was geht, was nicht geht und unter welchen Bedingungen. Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag und denkst in deinem eigenen Aufgabengebiet konsequent an Automatisierung. Du denkst unternehmerisch und bringst Dinge zu Ende, auch ohne perfekte Rahmenbedingungen. Ein reines 9-to-5-Mindset passt nicht zu dieser Rolle. Was wir dir bieten Maßgebliche Verantwortung für die Rechtsfunktion eines wachsenden, BaFin-beaufsichtigten Asset Managers: Du gestaltest, statt zu verwalten. Das erwartet Dich

Als Director Process Management (m/w/d) übernimmst Du die strategische Leitung des Prozessmanagements im Bereich IT-Infrastructure & Process Excellence und verantwortest den gesamten Prozesslebenszyklus – von der Gestaltung bis zur Optimierung.   • Du entwickelst Knowledge Management- und Prozessdigitalisierungsstrategien, förderst organisationsweites Lernen und Integration mit IT und Business-Systemen.

title: (Senior) Customer Success Manager (alle Geschlechter)
description: Deine High-Speed Mission Zu Speed Kit Speed Kit macht die Shops und Websites unserer Kunden messbar schneller, und schnellere Seiten heißen mehr Umsatz. Zu unseren Kunden gehören einige der bekanntesten E-Commerce-Marken in Deutschland und Europa. Zu deiner Rolle Customer Success bei uns ist deshalb keine Zufriedenheitsverwaltung, sondern die Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Kunde live geht, den Effekt auf sein Geschäft nachvollziehen kann und langfristig bleibt. Die initiale Unterschrift holen unsere Account Executives. Danach sitzt du im Driver Seat: Du bringst den Kunden durch Trial oder POC über die Ziellinie und behältst ihn anschließend in deinem Portfolio. Der Kunde bleibt deiner, mit allem was dazugehört. Was du verantwortest Du führst Trials und POCs deiner Neukunden: Du steuerst Integration und Konfiguration mit unserem Team und dem Kunden, koordinierst A/B-Test-Setup und Auswertung und hältst die Stakeholder zusammen. Du erkennst früh, wenn ein Projekt kippt, und drehst es. Du führst die Onboarding-Projekte als echte Projektleitung, von Kickoff über Go-live bis zur Ergebnispräsentation. Das ist der Schwerpunkt der Rolle. Du betreust deine Bestandskunden aus eigenem Antrieb. Du gehst auf deine Accounts zu, bevor sie sich melden, kennst ihre Roadmap und ihre Relaunches und bringst regelmäßig Ergebnisse und Ideen an den Tisch. Du trägst Umsatzverantwortung für dein Portfolio: Verlängerungen, Commitment-Upgrades, Überschreitungen, Ausbau in weitere Domains, Marken und Länder. Du weißt jederzeit, wo dein Book steht und warum. Und weil dein Erfolg unser Erfolg ist, profitierst du auch entsprechend davon. Du führst Kundengespräche auf Basis von Daten: Core Web Vitals, CrUX, Conversion-Uplift, ROI. Du kannst einen Uplift erklären und auch eine Verschlechterung, ohne auszuweichen. Du arbeitest täglich mit AI. Analysen, Reporting, Datenrecherche über unsere Systeme, Entwürfe für Kundenkommunikation: das machst du mit Claude und Gemini und baust dir eigene wiederverwendbare Workflows dafür. Wir erwarten kein Coding, aber wir erwarten, dass du dir selbst Hebel baust, statt Dinge manuell abzuarbeiten. Du bist die Spinne im Netz. Niemand im Unternehmen weiß so viel über unsere Kunden wie du, und du bringst dieses Wissen in alle Teams, von Engineering und Product über Sales bis zur Geschäftsführung. Wie es bei uns wirklich läuft Das Customer Success Team ist eine kleine, extrem eingespielte Truppe und liefert unseren Kunden echten, messbaren Mehrwert. Das ist eine High-Impact-Rolle: Was du bewegst, ist sofort sichtbar, im Ergebnis des Kunden und in unseren Zahlen. Dazu extrem flache Hierarchien, kein Freigabetheater, direkte Gespräche mit Engineering, Product und Geschäftsführung. Was du entscheidest, gilt. Dafür brauchst du aber auch eine eigene Meinung und den Mut, sie auszusprechen. Wenn du etwas anders siehst, sagst du es, und du bleibst dabei, auch wenn jemand widerspricht. Wir haben mehr Projekte als Hände. Ein Teil deiner Woche wird von außen bestimmt, deshalb ist gute Triage entscheidend: Du erkennst, welches der zehn offenen Themen heute Umsatz bewegt oder einen Kunden hält, und was warten kann. Du bekommst von uns Ziele, Kontext und Rückendeckung, aber niemand sortiert deine Prioritäten für dich. Dazu gehört auch, dass du den Mund aufmachst, wenn es brennt: nicht bei jeder Unsicherheit, sondern nachdem du selbst ernsthaft versucht hast, das Problem zu lösen. Keine Probleme, die drei Wochen im Stillen wachsen, und keine Eskalation für jede Frage, die du selbst beantworten könntest. Dein Ticket für unser Raumschiff Mindestens 2 Jahre Customer Success oder Account Management im B2B SaaS Erfahrung in der Steuerung technischer Onboarding-, Trial- oder Implementierungsprojekte mit mehreren Stakeholdern auf Kundenseite Erfahrung mit oder klare Bereitschaft zu echter Umsatzverantwortung. Du willst, dass dein Ergebnis an Kundenerfolg hängt, statt es zu vermeiden. AI-Tools als tägliches Arbeitsmittel. Das ist harte Voraussetzung und kein Pluspunkt. Wir werden dich im Bewerbungsprozess bitten, konkret zu zeigen, was du mit Claude, Gemini oder vergleichbaren Tools gebaut oder automatisiert hast. "Ich nutze ChatGPT manchmal für E-Mails" reicht dafür nicht. Selbstbewusstsein und Standing. Du trittst gegenüber Entscheidern auf Augenhöhe auf, führst auch unangenehme Gespräche über Preise, Verzögerungen und Erwartungen, und widersprichst einem Kunden freundlich, wenn er falsch liegt. Digitale Tools sind für dich selbstverständlich. Ein neues System bringst du dir selbst bei, statt auf eine Schulung zu warten. Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit und saubere Priorisierung unter Last Zahlen- und Datenaffinität. Du arbeitest sicher mit Traffic- und Performance-Metriken und leitest daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher Nice-to-have Verständnis von Web Performance, Core Web Vitals und dem Google CrUX Report Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren CRM E-Commerce-Hintergrund, idealerweise mit Shopsystemen wie Shopify, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopware oder Magento Warum einsteigen? Wir richten dir deinen Arbeitsplatz ein - vom Bildschirm bis zum Bürostuhl Wähle dein OS: Du kannst dein Betriebssystem frei wählen zwischen Mac, Windows oder Linux Schönes Büro: Arbeiten im Herzen des Hamburger Schanzenviertels Haustierfreundliches Büro: Du darfst gerne einen pelzigen Freund mitbringen Tolle Kolleg:innen: Kompetentes und humorvolles Team Flexibel arbeiten: Arbeite nach einem Vollzeit- oder Teilzeitplan Flache Hierarchien: Die besten Ideen gewinnen, egal von wem Event-Slots: Mehrmals im Jahr könnt ihr abstimmen, was gemacht wird - wolltest Du nicht schon immer mal mit deinen Kolleg:innen Kart fahren? Vote for it! Speed.Fest: Wir treffen uns jedes Quartal alle gemeinsam in unserem HQ in Hamburg für Workshops, gutes Essen, Events und eine tolle Zeit Persönliches Ausbildungsbudget: Wir helfen Dir, Deine Karriere und Deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen Monatliches, flexibles Benefit Budget: 50€ pro Monat, dass Du frei auf das für Dich passende Benefit verteilen kannst - von ÖPNV über Shopping Gutscheine bis hin zur Gym-Mitgliedschaft Zukunftssichere Altersvorsorge: Bringe deine Altersvorsorge mit oder lass dich von unseren Experten beraten Countdown 4️⃣… Du teilst deinen Lebenslauf, dein LinkedIn oder Xing-Profil mit uns. 3️⃣… Wir vereinbaren ein erstes ausführliches (Video-)Gespräch mit unserem Head of Customer Success zum Kennenlernen (45~60 Minuten). Wenn wir beide großes Interesse haben, bekommst du danach eine Case-Study-Simulation aus unserem echten Arbeitsalltag. Aufwand: maximal 2 Stunden, mehr wollen wir dir nicht zumuten. 2️⃣… Wir vereinbaren ein Gespräch mit unserem Head of Customer Success und einem Mitglied des CSM-Teams, inklusive Präsentation deiner Case-Study-Simulation (60~90 Minuten). 1️⃣… Abschlussgespräch mit unserem CEO (ca. 30 Minuten). Passt es für beide Seiten, bereiten wir den Vertrag vor. …0️⃣ Du steigst ein in unser Raumschiff! You will balance innovation, customer stewardship, product unification, and business needs while shaping the future role of visual collaboration in Wrike.</p> <p>This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine strong product strategy, people leadership, customer empathy, AI-native thinking, and organizational integration.   • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Bewertungs-, Finanzierungs- und Transaktionsfragen verständlich und praxisnah zu vermitteln
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Durchführung von Workshops, Informationsformaten oder fachlichen Veranstaltungen
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und eine sichere professionelle Kommunikation

Darauf folgt ein fachlicher Austausch; bei Bedarf ergänzen wir den Prozess um eine kurze und klar abgegrenzte Praxisaufgabe. Position Overview

Mendix is the leading low-code agentic enterprise platform. Our customers use Mendix to create and deploy better software for the enterprise, faster. Mendix enables collaboration between business users and developers to work together throughout the development process. Our group is responsible for driving innovation within Mendix as we work on modern technologies crucial to develop and deliver an Agentic Enterprise Platform to our customers. Our local team in Munich develops Agents Kit, the Mendix agent building SDK, so our customers can intuitively develop agents and agentic applications with an engaging end-user experience. You can find most of our components in the Mendix marketplace, and they can be used through Mendix Cloud GenAI Resource Packs.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Build upon an existing foundation, moving at a fast pace as the agentic AI space progresses
  • Work with early adopter customers to build out Agents Kit, an AI portfolio of modules and applications our customers really need
  • Work on a platform with a lasting impact and strategic value, knowing that thousands of developers and millions of end users across the globe rely on your work, and each commit can make a lot of impact
  • Be thorough and get to the bottom of things; clear answers are more important than deadlines
  • Work full-stack across technologies, delivering a Mendix SDK and leveraging TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, CSS, and Java

Qualifications

Required:

  • Mendix skills at the level of an Expert Developer with extensive knowledge of Mendix best practices for development
  • Comfortable writing a Java method or custom widget independently
  • Ability to learn new concepts and pick up new technologies based on tasks at hand, excited by the challenge of sophisticated technical problems
  • Take ownership for the quality of your work and the impact it has on others
  • Familiarity with agile frameworks and software development collaboration tools such as Git
  • Willingness to meet colleagues once or twice a week in a modern office in Munich

Preferred:
  • Background in the domain of generative AI, either through education or work experience in software development
  • Familiarity with technical concepts of MCP and/or A2A and other agent-building capabilities
  • Experience with Agents Kit and the Agent Editor in 11.9+
  • Experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, Python or another programming language
  • Day-to-day experience with agentic development tools such as Claude Code
  • Experience with generative AI services of cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and Google

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. description: Wir digitalisieren die Bauindustrie. Bist du dabei? Du arbeitest an einem Produkt mit echter Marktdurchdringung in einem riesigen DACH-Mittelstandsmarkt, lieferst Ergebnisse iterativ und übernimmst Ownership für Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren müssen und nicht nur im Konzept. Deine Rolle Als Werkstudent:in Finance & Accounting unterstützt du uns dabei, dass die finanziellen Abläufe von VESTIGAS im Tagesgeschäft zuverlässig funktionieren. Du arbeitest unter anderem an Rechnungen, offenen Posten, Buchhaltungsunterlagen und der Vorbereitung unserer Abschlüsse. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, bestehende Aufgaben abzuarbeiten. Viele unserer Finance-Prozesse werden aktuell aufgebaut und weiterentwickelt. Du erhältst deshalb einen direkten Einblick darin, wie die Finance-Funktion eines wachsenden Early-Stage-Start-ups entsteht – und kannst aktiv dazu beitragen, Abläufe strukturierter, effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten. Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Finance Managerin sowie unserem Steuerbüro zusammen. Zu Beginn lernst du unsere Prozesse und Systeme kennen, übernimmst operative Aufgaben und baust mit der Zeit deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich aus. Deine Aufgaben Du kontierst Eingangsrechnungen sowie Reisekosten- und Spesenabrechnungen in Moss vor und bereitest die Buchhaltungsunterlagen für unser Steuerbüro auf. Du erstellst Kundenrechnungen und kümmerst dich um die Nachverfolgung offener Forderungen. Du stimmst offene Posten auf Debitoren- und Kreditorenseite ab, behältst Fälligkeiten im Blick und klärst Unstimmigkeiten. Du pflegst Buchhaltungs- und Vertragsunterlagen und sorgst für eine vollständige, nachvollziehbare Ablage. Du wirkst bei der Vorbereitung der Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse mit und lernst, wie die einzelnen Finance-Prozesse zusammenlaufen. Du unterstützt beim Aufbau neuer Finance- und Accounting-Prozesse, bringst eigene Verbesserungsvorschläge ein und übernimmst mit zunehmender Erfahrung eigenständig ausgewählte Themen. Dein Profil Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, BWL oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang – idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Finance, Accounting oder Steuern. Du bringst im idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrung im Finance & Accounting mit, z. B. durch ein Praktikum, eine Ausbildung oder ein vorheriges Werkstudium. Du arbeitest strukturiert, genau und zuverlässig, auch bei wiederkehrenden Aufgaben und unter Termindruck. Du hast ein gutes Zahlenverständnis und Interesse daran, buchhalterische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und zu verbessern. Du wohnst in erreichbarer Nähe zu unserem Standort in München und bist bereit, regelmäßig im Büro präsent zu sein. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Excel oder Google Sheets; erste Erfahrungen mit Spend-Management-Tools ist ein Plus. Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Deine Benefits Echte Verantwortung statt Mikromanagement. Du gestaltest mit, du entscheidest mit, du siehst den Impact deiner Arbeit direkt im Markt. Direkter Draht zu Foundern und Leadership. Flache Hierarchien sind bei uns Alltag. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen. AI-First-Workflow. Copilot, Claude, Cursor und Co. sind bei uns selbstverständliches Werkzeug. Wir erwarten und unterstützen ihren Einsatz. Hybrides Arbeiten mit Office im Herzen Münchens, unweit der Theresienwiese. Flexibles Modell mit regelmäßiger Office-Präsenz, weil wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen auch im persönlichen Austausch entstehen. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Commodities &amp; Energy Trading practice is growing and we are hiring Consultants and Senior Consultants (m/w/d) to join our team in Düsseldorf or Munich. The level offered will reflect your experience, expertise and demonstrated impact.</span></span></h2> <p>We work with leading commodity and energy trading organisations, utilities, and large energy consumers, supporting them to navigate increasingly complex markets, manage flexibility in their portfolio and deliver large-scale transformation programmes. Clean Fuels, Power, Metals, or Oil. <br>We recognise that great candidates come from a variety of backgrounds, so you do not need experience across all of these areas to apply.</p> <ul> <li>Commodity and energy trading, risk management, market analysis, commercial operations or trading support functions.</li> <li>Trading transformation initiatives, helping organisations improve processes, systems and ways of working across the front-to-back trading lifecycle.</li> <li>Data, analytics and emerging AI-enabled use cases within trading environments.</li> <li>ETRM/CTRM platforms and supporting technologies, including business analysis, requirements gathering, testing, implementation or continuous improvement activities.</li> <li>Market, credit, operational or regulatory risk topics, with an interest in helping trading organisations strengthen governance, controls and performance.</li> </ul> <p>Depending on your experience and interests, you may also bring skills in one or more of the following areas:</p> <ul> <li>Business analysis, problem solving and transformation delivery experience.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, including data analysis and visualisation.</li> <li>Experience working with business and technology stakeholders to deliver practical solutions.</li> <li>An interest in data, analytics, AI and digital technologies within commodity and energy trading.</li> <li>Senior Consultants are expected to demonstrate ownership of workstreams, adapt quickly to complex situations, and thrive in client-facing environments.</li> <li>Professional proficiency in German and English is required for this role.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead
description: Your Impact Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part is not the software, it is that every single customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that gap is where most enterprise AI value quietly dies. Forward Deployed Engineering is how we close it: engineers who sit inside the customer's environment, build in their data, and turn what they learn into product. This function does not exist at Tacto yet. You will build the motion from the start, collaborating with Product, and discover what Forward Deployed Engineering means for Tacto, figuring out how much value we can generate for leading industrials. Your Tasks Build the function. Charter, operating model, quality bar, metrics. Bring this function to the next level. Hire the right talent. The team is there to grow. Hire exceptional Forward Deployed Engineers and build your own high performing team. Own how we engage customers. Design and establish the processes for how engineers scope, embed, build, and hand over. This is the core of the role, not an afterthought to the technical work. Build, hands-on, in customer environments. Agents, pipelines, custom logic on top of our platform, in real production data. You lead by shipping. Turn one-offs into product. Work directly with Product and Engineering to convert what you build at the edge into platform capability. An FDE org that productises nothing is just an expensive consultancy, and you will make sure we never become one. Lead the first FDEs. Find the rare people who are excellent engineers and credible in front of a Head of IT. Set the standard by being it. Own the hardest customer rooms. Lead escalations with Heads of Procurement and IT and be the senior presence customers trust. Be AI-native. Use AI to change what the function is capable of, then measure it, then build it into how the team works. Your Profile 5+ years building software close to customers: forward deployed or deployment-style engineering, technical program leadership in a product company, or an engineering-heavy path through top-tier consulting at Manager level or above. You write code and you want to keep writing it. Python and SQL at working level, comfortable with data pipelines and integration architecture. 1+ years leading engineers, or you have built something from zero and had people follow you into it. Zero-to-one operator. You are comfortable when the process does not exist yet, and you write it down instead of holding it in your head. Product instinct. You can tell a one-off from a pattern and you will argue the case either way. Senior presence with customers, including C-level escalations, and the backbone to be clear about what we will and will not commit to. Native or C1 German, fluent English. Why This Role is Awesome You are not inheriting a team, you are defining a function that most companies in enterprise AI are only starting to understand they need. Do this well for 12 to 18 months and you own one of Tacto's core technical organisations, with a direct line into the product roadmap and a hand in how leading global industrials adopts AI. What This Role Is - and Isn't This is not a people-management role with technical decoration. If you want to stop building, this is the wrong job. This is not consulting. Nobody here bills days. You are measured on what customers can do afterwards and on what made it into the platform. The first months will be ambiguous by design: you, a handful of accounts, and a blank page. If that reads as risk rather than opportunity, this is not a good fit. Why Tacto Backed to win big. We are Sequoia and Index-funded with €50M+ behind us. Our founders sit at the same table as the people defining the global AI agenda. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI. A truly AI-native organization, with every resource you could dream of. All the leading AI tools and custom agents at your fingertips, plus dedicated people who keep us at the frontier. High bar, high speed, genuinely fun. You'll be surrounded by extremely smart and ambitious people who set the bar high and push you to get better every week. Intense, fast, and the opposite of boring. A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem. Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events (Lunch & Learns, hackathons, community gatherings). Check out all upcoming and past events here: https://luma.com/tacto You'll build something that lasts and that matters. You'll help build the company that keeps European industry competitive for the long term. Interview Process Intro call with our Talent team Deep dive with Head of Customer Experience Onsite case study and discussion on future of FDEs Our Background Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material. Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans. Why It Matters Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives. But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech. raw.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead
raw.description:
Your Impact

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part is not the software, it is that every single customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that gap is where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

Forward Deployed Engineering is how we close it: engineers who sit inside the customer's environment, build in their data, and turn what they learn into product. This function does not exist at Tacto yet. You will build the motion from the start, collaborating with Product, and discover what Forward Deployed Engineering means for Tacto, figuring out how much value we can generate for leading industrials.

Your Tasks

  • Build the function. Charter, operating model, quality bar, metrics. Bring this function to the next level.

  • Hire the right talent. The team is there to grow. Hire exceptional Forward Deployed Engineers and build your own high performing team.

  • Own how we engage customers. Design and establish the processes for how engineers scope, embed, build, and hand over. This is the core of the role, not an afterthought to the technical work.

  • Build, hands-on, in customer environments. Agents, pipelines, custom logic on top of our platform, in real production data. You lead by shipping.

  • Turn one-offs into product. Work directly with Product and Engineering to convert what you build at the edge into platform capability. An FDE org that productises nothing is just an expensive consultancy, and you will make sure we never become one.

  • Lead the first FDEs. Find the rare people who are excellent engineers and credible in front of a Head of IT. Set the standard by being it.

  • Own the hardest customer rooms. Lead escalations with Heads of Procurement and IT and be the senior presence customers trust.

  • Be AI-native. Use AI to change what the function is capable of, then measure it, then build it into how the team works.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years building software close to customers: forward deployed or deployment-style engineering, technical program leadership in a product company, or an engineering-heavy path through top-tier consulting at Manager level or above.

  • You write code and you want to keep writing it. Python and SQL at working level, comfortable with data pipelines and integration architecture.

  • 1+ years leading engineers, or you have built something from zero and had people follow you into it.

  • Zero-to-one operator. You are comfortable when the process does not exist yet, and you write it down instead of holding it in your head.

  • Product instinct. You can tell a one-off from a pattern and you will argue the case either way.

  • Senior presence with customers, including C-level escalations, and the backbone to be clear about what we will and will not commit to.

  • Native or C1 German, fluent English.

Why This Role is Awesome

You are not inheriting a team, you are defining a function that most companies in enterprise AI are only starting to understand they need. Do this well for 12 to 18 months and you own one of Tacto's core technical organisations, with a direct line into the product roadmap and a hand in how leading global industrials adopts AI.

What This Role Is - and Isn't

  • This is not a people-management role with technical decoration. If you want to stop building, this is the wrong job.

  • This is not consulting. Nobody here bills days. You are measured on what customers can do afterwards and on what made it into the platform.

  • The first months will be ambiguous by design: you, a handful of accounts, and a blank page. If that reads as risk rather than opportunity, this is not a good fit.

Why Tacto

  • Backed to win big. We are Sequoia and Index-funded with €50M+ behind us. Our founders sit at the same table as the people defining the global AI agenda. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI.

  • A truly AI-native organization, with every resource you could dream of. All the leading AI tools and custom agents at your fingertips, plus dedicated people who keep us at the frontier.

  • High bar, high speed, genuinely fun. You'll be surrounded by extremely smart and ambitious people who set the bar high and push you to get better every week. Intense, fast, and the opposite of boring.

  • A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem. Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events (Lunch & Learns, hackathons, community gatherings). Check out all upcoming and past events here: https://luma.com/tacto

  • You'll build something that lasts and that matters. You'll help build the company that keeps European industry competitive for the long term.

Interview Process

  1. Intro call with our Talent team

  2. Deep dive with Head of Customer Experience

  3. Onsite case study and discussion on future of FDEs

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Every founder has a list of (strategic) initiatives with tremendous potential that lack time to be realized and belong to no one yet. As a Founders Associate, that list is your job. You'll be the right hand to C-level and founders - taking the hardest, highest-leverage, cross-functional initiatives off their plate and driving them to done, with real ownership from day one and access almost no one else in the company has.

We hire for the person first, then match you to one of two tracks:

Track 1 - Generalist

  • Own the most important company-wide initiatives directly with our CEO. Whatever stands between Tacto and its next growth phase that quarter, you take it and drive it to done.

  • Build new bets from 0 to 1: new product wedges, growth loops, and ideas that could become standalone engines inside Tacto

  • Operate as a "founder within the company," moving from strategy to hands-on execution and back

  • Go where the leverage is: one month it's org and hiring, the next a product wedge or a new market

Track 2 - Go-to-Market

  • Analyze new markets, industries, and segments, and build the business cases and go-to-market plans to enter them.

  • Identify our next growth opportunities, e.g. new modules or motions, and turn them into concrete execution plans.

  • Support the executive team directly: prepare and run C-level meetings with our most important customers, and own the analyses behind them.

  • Help our revenue leadership reshape the GTM engine and make Tacto the best go-to-market organization in Europe

Your Profile

  • Smart, driven, and hungry to build - you get energy from moving fast and seeing results

  • You think strategically but don’t shy away from hands-on execution

  • You've seen what "great" looks like - through a role or internship at a top-tier startup, in consulting, or VC

  • Extreme ownership: you build the roadmap, find solutions, and don't wait for permission

  • You've built something from zero before - and we could see ourselves backing you if you started your own company one day

  • Ego-free overachiever who makes everyone around them better

  • Fluent in German and English

Why This Role is Awesome

You'll get rare exposure to our founders and senior leadership, working right next to them on Tacto’s most important projects. The growth trajectory of this company depends on the success of the projects you own.
It's broad by design: you'll move across different topics and go deep wherever the leverage is, building the instincts you'd need to run a company yourself one day. Most Founders Associates earn a clear next step within 12-18 months, whether that's leading a function, owning a commercial role, spinning up a new business line, or going on to found their own company.

What This Role Is - and Isn't

We want to be honest about what you're signing up for:

  • This is a role for people who love to roll up their sleeves and get things done - building, analyzing, and shipping, not advising from the sidelines. You take whatever the most important problem is, even when it's messy, cross-functional, or unglamorous.

  • You'll own real problems end to end, move fast, and figure things out as you go. In return you get things that are rare and valuable: direct, visible impact, real ownership from day one, and daily exposure to our founders and senior leadership.

  • The deal: prove yourself, deliver real impact, make a strong case for yourself - then we'll back your next step in every way possible, inside Tacto or beyond.

Why Tacto

  • We bet on young talent and mean it. We consistently back smart, hungry, young people with real ownership early. 70%+ of our Leadership Team was promoted internally - you deliver impact and sky is the limit at Tacto.

  • Backed to win big. We are Sequoia and Index-funded and have €50M+ behind us. Our founders sit at the same table as the people defining the global AI agenda, from Sam Altman to Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI.

  • A truly AI-native organization, with every resource you could dream of. All the leading AI tools and custom agents at your fingertips, plus dedicated "AI captains" who keep us at the frontier.

  • High bar, high speed, genuinely fun. You'll be surrounded by extremely smart and ambitious people who set the bar high and push you to get better every week. Intense, fast, and the opposite of boring.

  • A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem. Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events, e.g. with Andreas Klinger, Judith Dada or during large Hackathons. Check out all upcoming and past events here: https://luma.com/tacto

  • You'll build something that lasts and that matters. You'll help build the company that keeps European industry competitive for the long-term.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Technical Recruiter, Sydney
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>As a key member of Anduril's recruiting team, you will be responsible for the company's talent management as we continue to rapidly grow. Hardware-meets-software work, on the floor, in production.<br><br>Concretely, the two flagship things you'll build:</p> <ul> <li>The manufacturing-line console. Pre-programmed for PCBA bring-up and bottle bring-up. Technicians execute curated, version-controlled tests through a GUI. They do not author command-line.</li> <li>The vehicle-level test base. A pre-programmed console for vehicle Factory Acceptance Test and system check-out. Same as manufacturing-line console.</li> </ul> <p>Behind both: one framework, one config-managed toolchain, one OS target for test execution, and a CI/CD discipline for test code that today doesn't exist.<br><br><br><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and build a production utility suite of tools. These are the two consoles that the production team will live in.</li> <li>Test framework architecture. NixOS-based, declarative, reproducible. Drive the move off mixed Linux/ Windows/ Mac/ NixOS dev environments to a single config-managed target.</li> <li>CI/CD for test code. Test software ships through pipelines, not over USB sticks. Stand it up, maintain it, hold the line on review and version control.</li> <li>Integration with Anduril's factory systems: MES (work instructions, routings, defect capture), Oracle ERP, Teamcenter PLM where relevant. Test results should land in the systems where they're traced and acted on, not in spreadsheets.</li> <li>Technician-facing usability. GUIs that lower the entry-skill bar. Curated, version-controlled tests. Clear pass/fail. Helpful error codes that point at the actual problem, not at a stack trace.</li> <li>Cross-site codebase convergence with other Anduril production sites. You're part of converging the AU and US Manufacturing Test stacks — shared framework, shared XL Utility code, common error-code library. You'll work with the US team to make that real.</li> <li>Floor support. When a test fails and it's not clear whether it's the product, the tester, or the test code — you debug it. You're the one called when the GUI throws an unexpected error and the build's stopped.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engineering fundamentals. Degree in Software, Computer, Electrical, Mechatronic, or related engineering — or equivalent demonstrable experience. You can read a schematic and reason about what the test code is actually exercising.</li> <li>Strong software fluency for test automation. Python first, with real experience building, maintaining, and debugging test frameworks — not just scripts. You write code other people can read, change, and ship.</li> <li>Linux + command line as a primary environment. You live in a shell. You write Bash where it makes sense. You're comfortable with system-level configuration, process management, and network debugging — not as a special skill, just as how you work.</li> <li>Hardware-software interface fluency. You've written software that drives test instruments and hardware-under-test through real interfaces — USB, Ethernet, RS232/RS485, CAN, I2C, SPI, GPIB, or equivalent.</li> <li>Electronics troubleshooting hands-on. You can pick up an oscilloscope, a multimeter, or a logic analyser and isolate whether a problem is in the product, the tester, or the cable between them. You don't escalate the question — you get hands on and answer it.</li> <li>GUI development experience. You've built user-facing test consoles or operator interfaces — frameworks vary (PyQt, Tkinter, web stacks, LabVIEW front panels) but you understand what makes a tech-facing GUI usable vs frustrating, and you can ship one.</li> <li>Software-engineering discipline. You version-control test code. You write tests for the test code where it matters. You think about reproducibility, configuration management, and rollback before they bite.</li> <li>Bias to action and ownership. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic SDLC - (EMEA Only)</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.</p> <p>You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.</p> <h2><strong>Why this role exists</strong></h2> <p>Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.</p> <p>Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Level Up Your Career with Zynga!</strong></p> <p>At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.</p> <p>From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires &amp; Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles &amp; Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!</p> <p>Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.</p> <p>Join us and be part of the play!</p></div><p><strong>Position Overview:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a versatile Senior Localization Producer with strong experience in MT/LLM-enabled workflows to join our International Production Team, working from either our London or Barcelona offices.</p> <p>As part of our global team spanning multiple studio locations, you will champion localization and culturalization for assigned games and central projects, and help drive our global localization strategies and objectives at department level, especially around MT and LLM integrations. You will act as a thought partner to game and central tools teams, help solve complex localization problems, and lead the charge in utilizing and maintaining AI-enabled workflows at scale. If you’re a localization forward-thinker, thrive in cross-functional environments, and are passionate about delivering world-class experiences to international players, we want to hear from you!</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <p><strong>Cross-team initiatives, MT/AI Integrations</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Drive AI Integrations:</strong> Be a key contributor to our MT &amp; AI localization initiatives. Help shape the roadmap and coordinate integration, maintenance and improvements with both external partners and internal teams.</li> <li><strong>Innovate Workflows:</strong> Proactively spot opportunities where new integrations with MT and LLM-based tools, or automation can improve localization and LQA quality, efficiency, and scalability.</li> <li><strong>Define Global Standards:</strong> Lead initiatives across the team to define, track, and uphold Localization/LQA standards and performance KPIs. Stay current on industry trends and make pragmatic recommendations.</li> <li><strong>Champion Culturalization:</strong> Ensure development practices build in internationalization and a global mindset from the start, helping game teams see the value of excellent localization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Assigned Games &amp; Central Projects</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Partner with Game Teams &amp; Own the Localization Pipeline:</strong> Promote internationalization best practices, manage schedules, language requirements, project planning, translation and LQA execution, and overall international roadmaps for assigned new game launches and live service operations.</li> <li><strong>Manage Budgets:</strong> Establish, maintain, and track localization budgets at project level. Escalate overspending trends and implement action plans to optimize costs.</li> <li><strong>Drive LQA Strategy &amp; Bug Resolution:</strong> Fully own the resolution of localization bugs. title: Software Engineer - Open Source
description: <p>Cambridge, UK | Full-time | Permanent&nbsp;| Hybrid</p> <p>Salary: £64,000 - £76,000 DOE&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About us</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved.&nbsp; Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.&nbsp;</p> <p>Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&amp;D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the role </strong></p> <p>At Riverlane, our mission is to make it possible for anyone to write and run fault-tolerant programs on a quantum computer. A key part of that mission is&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/Deltakit/deltakit">Deltakit,</a> our open-source, user-facing software platform for building, simulating and interpreting QEC experiments. As a Software Engineer, you will play a central role in shaping and evolving <a href="https://github.com/Deltakit/deltakit">Deltakit</a>, ensuring it continues to meet the needs of a rapidly growing and highly technical community.</p> <p>This is a role at the intersection of research and engineering. You’ll work closely with leading experts in QEC, translating cutting-edge ideas into robust, intuitive software that researchers can rely on. Your work will directly influence how users interact with Riverlane’s software ecosystem, helping to bridge the gap between theoretical advances and practical application.</p> <p>Beyond building features, you’ll engage actively with our user community, supporting adoption, understanding how people are using <a href="https://github.com/Deltakit/deltakit">Deltakit</a>, and turning feedback into thoughtful, well-engineered improvements. Through this, you’ll help strengthen Riverlane’s position at the forefront of QEC software while ensuring the tools we build are genuinely impactful and accessible.</p> <p>Riverlane is tackling ambitious challenges in a fast-moving, emerging field. description: <p><strong><u>The Role</u></strong></p> <p>As a Software Engineer with a <strong>minimum of 15 years of experience</strong>, you’ll work on our in-house package, 'Miles,' an ERP software for automotive finance, leasing, fleet, and mobility management. This end-to-end solution encompasses front, mid, and back-office functions that can be extensively customized to the customers’ needs through configuration and custom development.</p> <p>You’ll be part of a multidisciplinary team that includes other developers, business consultants, and testers, covering our end-to-end business flow. You can rely on a broad base of knowledge and expertise.</p> <p>Every team in Sofico works in an agile way, including scrum, daily stand-ups, and backlog refinement. Additionally, you’ll be joining our Java community, which connects all the Software Engineers within Sofico worldwide to share best practices, code, tips, and tricks.</p> <p><strong><u>The Right Fit for the Role</u></strong></p> <p>A passion for developing and building solutions is at the top of our list. As a Software Engineer, it is also key to keep the bigger picture in mind and understand how different elements are intertwined. Problem-solving is one of your strongest abilities, and you approach it methodically. If you are a team player who <strong>enjoys collaborating </strong>and <strong>sharing knowledge</strong>, you’re the perfect blend of technical and soft skills.</p> <p>This position, based in <strong>Sydney</strong>, offers a hybrid work model: three days in-office and two days remote.&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Candidates must possess full working rights in Australia; sponsorship is not available.</em></p> <p>In your application, elaborate on the following aspects of your career:</p> <ul> <li>Experience spanning over <strong>15 years</strong></li> <li>Expertise as either a Full Stack Developer or specialized in Back End development</li> <li>Proficiency in <strong>Java 17, Java EE 7, SQL/JPA, Hibernate</strong></li> <li>Familiarity with <strong>Agile</strong> Methodology</li> <li>Exposure to <strong>Automotive, Finance, or Leasing</strong> industries</li> <li>Experience in <strong>Monolithic </strong>and <strong>Microservices</strong> architecture</li> <li>Significance in constructing and deploying solutions, both internally and for clients</li> <li>Engagement in enhancing current applications, developing new modules, or executing customization projects for clients</li> <li>Demonstration of adeptly <strong>resolving complex problems</strong> in a systematic manner, with project-specific details provided in your application</li> <li>Strong communication skills, including client interaction</li> <li>Fluency in English, given our international and multicultural environment</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>About Us</u></strong></p> <p>Discover how Sofico empowers businesses in 27 countries worldwide. With offices in Australia, Belgium, France, Germany, Japan, Mexico, the Netherlands, and the UK, our Sydney-based hub manages clients across Australia and Asia.</p> <p>Our flagship product, Miles, has completed over 60 successful implementations and earned a solid reputation in automotive finance, leasing, fleet, and mobility management. It's an ERP system renowned for its unmatched flexibility.</p> <p>Sofico operates at the intersection of rapidly transforming industries: automotive, finance, leasing, and IT. This convergence sparks innovation as our clients pioneer new product offerings, focusing on mobility solutions enabled by connected cars.</p> <p>Join us—a multinational company with over 600 staff—as we lead the way in industry innovation. Unlock new possibilities with Sofico.</p> <p><strong><u>What We Offer</u></strong></p> <p>At Sofico, we welcome you to an international and multicultural company that has been thriving for over 30 years and is doubling in size every five years. Growth is in our DNA, and we strongly uphold our horizontal and open company culture.</p> <ul> <li>Take control of your career with a focus on personal development.</li> <li>Participate in an extensive six-month onboarding program, supported by a dedicated job coach.</li> <li>Enjoy continuous opportunities for learning and professional growth.</li> <li>Work in a modern, state-of-the-art office that's easily accessible.</li> <li>Onsite parking and walking distance from metro.</li> <li>Benefit from a competitive salary, flexible office hours.</li> <li>Hybrid option to work from home two days a week.</li> <li>Access novated leasing options and mobile phone reimbursement.</li> <li>Enjoy complimentary coffee, soft drinks, breakfast and fruit</li> <li>Participate in team events, including afterwork drinks, BBQs, family days, and company weekends.</li> </ul> <p>If you’re ready to join a dynamic team and take your career to the next level, apply today!</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Small Business Account Executive I
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.</p></div><p><strong>About the Revenue team</strong></p> <p>The Revenue team drives Affirm's top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimisation to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm's products.<br>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>As a Small Business Account Executive I, you'll fuel Affirm's UK growth by acquiring and onboarding small and mid-sized merchants. You'll own a high-volume pipeline end to end, introducing merchants to Affirm's buy now, pay later products and helping them grow through flexible, honest financing.<br>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, pitch, negotiate, and close new SMB merchant partnerships across the UK market.</li> <li>Build and manage a healthy, high-volume pipeline, consistently meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly quota.</li> <li>Run consultative conversations with founders, owners, and decision-makers, tailoring Affirm's value proposition to each merchant's goals.</li> <li>Drive merchant activation and early adoption, partnering with onboarding and account management teams to ensure a smooth launch.</li> <li>Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, and activity data in the CRM.</li> <li>Act as a voice of the UK SMB market internally, sharing feedback with Product, Marketing, and Partnerships to improve our offering.<br>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of consultative, quota-carrying sales experience, ideally in fintech, SaaS, payments, or retail technology.</li> <li>2+ years of experience selling into the UK market, with a strong understanding of the SMB merchant landscape.</li> <li>Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets.</li> <li>Excellent communication, storytelling, and relationship-building skills.</li> <li>Comfortable managing a high volume of deals and navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>A collaborative, resilient, and growth-minded approach; understanding of eCommerce, in-store technology, and payments ecosystems is a plus.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Base Pay Grade - D</p> <p>Equity Grade - 3</p> <p>Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, which includes the annual base pay and the sales incentive target.</p> <p>Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidised medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).</p> <p>GBR On Target Earnings per year including base and variable components: £92,000 - £112,000</p> <p>Location: Remote UK</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.</span></p> <p class="p1">[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.</p> </div> <div> <p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a>&nbsp;and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as described therein.</p> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
